question: Which obligor groups are over their approved credit limit once all their subsidiaries are rolled up?
answer:
**Three of the 25 obligor groups are over their approved limit once current subsidiaries are rolled up: Halvorsen, Brightwater and Corvane.** Together they're about $102M over. The other 22 groups are within their limits.

| Obligor group (ultimate parent) | Limit | Lending commitments (active) | Derivatives current exposure | **Total exposure** | **Utilisation** | Excess |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Brightwater Group Inc (LE-10030) | $200.0M | $236.6M (21 facilities) | $0 | **$236.6M** | **118.3%** | $36.6M |
| Halvorsen Industrial Group Inc (LE-10001) | $300.0M | $308.0M (10 facilities) | $36.3M (7 trades) | **$344.3M** | **114.8%** | $44.3M |
| Corvane Partners Inc (LE-10052) | $150.0M | $171.2M (16 facilities) | $0 (3 trades, none in the money) | **$171.2M** | **114.1%** | $21.2M |

- **The breaches come from lending commitments.** In all three groups, loan commitments alone are already above the limit. Halvorsen's derivatives exposure only makes its excess bigger.
- **Groups close to their limit:** Stellmark is at 91.5% ($164.7M of $180M) and Ridgeport at 90.1% ($108.1M of $120M). Marrowind is at 82.9% and Valewood at 81.1%.
- **Measuring on drawn balances instead of commitments gives no breaches.** Halvorsen would be at 86.8%, Brightwater 85.6% and Corvane 87.6%. So the breaches are caused by the bank's committed but undrawn amounts, not by money already lent.
- **Using the current ownership tree matters.** The old (legacy) group hierarchy table was last updated on 2024-11-30. It would still count:
  - Halvorsen Marine Logistics, which moved to Tidemark Shipping on 2025-12-01 ($60M commitment).
  - Ridgeport Specialty Chemicals, which moved to Sorvik Chemical on 2026-04-01 ($25M).
  - Two joint ventures that are no longer controlled.

  On that basis Stellmark (108%) and Ridgeport (111%) would wrongly show as breaches.
- **Don't use the $187.5M Halvorsen figure in the sandbox table.** It is dated 2025-03-31, counts direct subsidiaries only, and is marked as work in progress. It understates the group's exposure.

**Sources and definitions**
- **Limits:** credit limit table in the risk database (Fabric). All 25 limits are group-level, approved in 2025, with next review on 2026-12-31. Each limit holder was confirmed to be the top of its ownership tree.
- **Group membership:** ownership table in the risk database. Only controlling links (51–100% owned) in effect on 2026-09-30 were used. The tree was followed up to 7 levels; no circular ownership was found. Non-controlling stakes (23–46%) and ended links were left out.
- **Linking entities to bank clients:** each risk-database entity carries a 5-digit client number, matched to the bank's 10-digit zero-padded number. All 312 client numbers in these groups matched.
- **Lending exposure:** commitment amounts on ACTIVE facilities from the bank's lending data (Snowflake), across all products including standby letters of credit. At 2026-09-30, drawn plus undrawn equals the commitment for these facilities, and no facility is drawn above its commitment. Paid-off and charged-off facilities are excluded.
- **Derivatives exposure:** current exposure from the capital-markets exposure table at 2026-09-30 (positive mark-to-market, one row per trade, no duplicates).
- **Guarantees:** all 47 active guarantees given by entities in these groups cover borrowers inside the same group. I didn't add them, because that would count the same exposure twice.

**Assumptions**
- Group exposure = lending commitments + derivatives current exposure, with no add-on for potential future derivatives exposure and no netting or collateral offsets. Including potential future exposure would only push utilisation higher.
- Nothing in this analysis needed restricted data; the financial-crime tables were not used.

sql.sql: SELECT LIMIT_TYP, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID) np, MIN(APPROVED_DT) mina, MAX(APPROVED_DT) maxa, MIN(NEXT_REVIEW_DT) minr, MAX(NEXT_REVIEW_DT) maxr, SUM(LIMIT_AMT) amt FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT GROUP BY LIMIT_TYP

SELECT CONTROL_FLG, COUNT(*) n, MIN(OWN_PCT) mn, MAX(OWN_PCT) mx, SUM(CASE WHEN EFF_TO < '2026-09-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ended, SUM(CASE WHEN EFF_FROM > '2026-09-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) future, COUNT(DISTINCT CHILD_ENTITY_ID) nchild FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP GROUP BY CONTROL_FLG

SELECT ENTITY_TYP, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN CIF_REF IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) withcif, MIN(LEN(CIF_REF)) minlen, MAX(LEN(CIF_REF)) maxlen, COUNT(DISTINCT CIF_REF) dcif FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY GROUP BY ENTITY_TYP

SELECT o.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP o2 WHERE o2.CHILD_ENTITY_ID=o.CHILD_ENTITY_ID) nrows FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP o WHERE o.EFF_TO < '9999-12-31' OR o.CHILD_ENTITY_ID IN (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP GROUP BY CHILD_ENTITY_ID HAVING COUNT(*)>1) ORDER BY CHILD_ENTITY_ID, EFF_FROM

WITH o AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30'),
t AS (SELECT l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID root, l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID ent, 0 lvl FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT l
 UNION ALL SELECT t.root, o.c, t.lvl+1 FROM t JOIN o ON o.p=t.ent WHERE t.lvl<15)
SELECT t.root, le.ENTITY_NM, COUNT(*) n_ent, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ent) n_dist, MAX(lvl) maxlvl, SUM(CASE WHEN e.CIF_REF IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_cif,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o WHERE o.c=t.root) root_has_parent
FROM t JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY le ON le.ENTITY_ID=t.root JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e ON e.ENTITY_ID=t.ent
GROUP BY t.root, le.ENTITY_NM ORDER BY t.root

sql.sql:
WITH o AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30')
SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN o1.p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) l1, SUM(CASE WHEN o2.p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) l2, SUM(CASE WHEN o3.p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) l3, SUM(CASE WHEN o4.p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) l4, SUM(CASE WHEN o5.p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) l5, SUM(CASE WHEN o6.p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) l6, SUM(CASE WHEN o7.p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) l7
FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e LEFT JOIN o o1 ON o1.c=e.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN o o2 ON o2.c=o1.p LEFT JOIN o o3 ON o3.c=o2.p LEFT JOIN o o4 ON o4.c=o3.p LEFT JOIN o o5 ON o5.c=o4.p LEFT JOIN o o6 ON o6.c=o5.p LEFT JOIN o o7 ON o7.c=o6.p

WITH o AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30')
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o7.p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) l7, SUM(CASE WHEN o8.p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) l8, SUM(CASE WHEN o9.p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) l9, SUM(CASE WHEN o10.p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) l10, SUM(CASE WHEN o11.p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) l11, SUM(CASE WHEN o12.p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) l12
FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e LEFT JOIN o o1 ON o1.c=e.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN o o2 ON o2.c=o1.p LEFT JOIN o o3 ON o3.c=o2.p LEFT JOIN o o4 ON o4.c=o3.p LEFT JOIN o o5 ON o5.c=o4.p LEFT JOIN o o6 ON o6.c=o5.p LEFT JOIN o o7 ON o7.c=o6.p LEFT JOIN o o8 ON o8.c=o7.p LEFT JOIN o o9 ON o9.c=o8.p LEFT JOIN o o10 ON o10.c=o9.p LEFT JOIN o o11 ON o11.c=o10.p LEFT JOIN o o12 ON o12.c=o11.p

WITH o AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30'),
u AS (SELECT e.ENTITY_ID, e.CIF_REF, COALESCE(o7.p,o6.p,o5.p,o4.p,o3.p,o2.p,o1.p,e.ENTITY_ID) ult
FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e LEFT JOIN o o1 ON o1.c=e.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN o o2 ON o2.c=o1.p LEFT JOIN o o3 ON o3.c=o2.p LEFT JOIN o o4 ON o4.c=o3.p LEFT JOIN o o5 ON o5.c=o4.p LEFT JOIN o o6 ON o6.c=o5.p LEFT JOIN o o7 ON o7.c=o6.p)
SELECT l.LIMIT_ID, l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID, le.ENTITY_NM, l.LIMIT_AMT, ru.ult root_ult, COUNT(u.ENTITY_ID) n_ent, SUM(CASE WHEN u.CIF_REF IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_cif
FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT l JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY le ON le.ENTITY_ID=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID
LEFT JOIN u ru ON ru.ENTITY_ID=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID
LEFT JOIN u ON u.ult=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID
GROUP BY l.LIMIT_ID, l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID, le.ENTITY_NM, l.LIMIT_AMT, ru.ult ORDER BY l.LIMIT_ID

SELECT SNAP_DT, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT TRADE_ID) nt, SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE<>CASE WHEN MTM_AMT>0 THEN MTM_AMT ELSE 0 END THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ce_ne_mtm FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE GROUP BY SNAP_DT ORDER BY SNAP_DT
SELECT PRODUCT, COUNT(*) n FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE WHERE SNAP_DT='2026-09-30' GROUP BY PRODUCT

WITH o AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30'),
u AS (SELECT e.ENTITY_ID, e.CIF_REF, COALESCE(o7.p,o6.p,o5.p,o4.p,o3.p,o2.p,o1.p,e.ENTITY_ID) ult
FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e LEFT JOIN o o1 ON o1.c=e.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN o o2 ON o2.c=o1.p LEFT JOIN o o3 ON o3.c=o2.p LEFT JOIN o o4 ON o4.c=o3.p LEFT JOIN o o5 ON o5.c=o4.p LEFT JOIN o o6 ON o6.c=o5.p LEFT JOIN o o7 ON o7.c=o6.p),
cm AS (SELECT u.ult, SUM(x.CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, COUNT(*) ntr FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE x JOIN u ON u.ENTITY_ID=x.ENTITY_ID WHERE x.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30' GROUP BY u.ult)
SELECT l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID, ISNULL(cm.ce,0) cm_ce, ISNULL(cm.ntr,0) ntr,
 (SELECT STRING_AGG(u.CIF_REF, ',') FROM u WHERE u.ult=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID AND u.CIF_REF IS NOT NULL) cifs
FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT l LEFT JOIN cm ON cm.ult=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.FACILITY_STATUS, f.PRODUCT_CD, COUNT(*) n, SUM(COMMIT_AMT) commit, SUM(IFF(f.PAYOFF_DT IS NOT NULL,1,0)) payoff, SUM(IFF(f.CHGOFF_DT IS NOT NULL,1,0)) chgoff, SUM(IFF(b.FACILITY_ID IS NOT NULL,1,0)) has_sep_bal, SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT) drawn, SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT) tot
FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.FACILITY_ID=f.FACILITY_ID AND b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH o AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30'),
u AS (SELECT e.ENTITY_ID, e.ENTITY_NM, e.CIF_REF, COALESCE(o7.p,o6.p,o5.p,o4.p,o3.p,o2.p,o1.p,e.ENTITY_ID) ult
FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e LEFT JOIN o o1 ON o1.c=e.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN o o2 ON o2.c=o1.p LEFT JOIN o o3 ON o3.c=o2.p LEFT JOIN o o4 ON o4.c=o3.p LEFT JOIN o o5 ON o5.c=o4.p LEFT JOIN o o6 ON o6.c=o5.p LEFT JOIN o o7 ON o7.c=o6.p)
SELECT u.ENTITY_ID, u.ENTITY_NM, u.CIF_REF, u.ult cur_ult, h.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID legacy_ult
FROM u LEFT JOIN dbo.CPTY_HIER_LEGACY h ON h.ENTITY_ID=u.ENTITY_ID
WHERE u.ENTITY_ID IN ('LE-10002','LE-10007','LE-10029','LE-10101','LE-10102','LE-10164','LE-10171','LE-10212','LE-10244','LE-10334','LE-10357','LE-10419')
 OR (h.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID IS NOT NULL AND h.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID<>u.ult AND (h.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID IN (SELECT ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT) OR u.ult IN (SELECT ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT)))

WITH o AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30'),
u AS (SELECT e.ENTITY_ID, e.CIF_REF, COALESCE(o7.p,o6.p,o5.p,o4.p,o3.p,o2.p,o1.p,e.ENTITY_ID) ult
FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e LEFT JOIN o o1 ON o1.c=e.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN o o2 ON o2.c=o1.p LEFT JOIN o o3 ON o3.c=o2.p LEFT JOIN o o4 ON o4.c=o3.p LEFT JOIN o o5 ON o5.c=o4.p LEFT JOIN o o6 ON o6.c=o5.p LEFT JOIN o o7 ON o7.c=o6.p)
SELECT g.GUARANTEE_ID, g.FACILITY_ID, g.GUARANTOR_ENTITY_ID, u.ult guarantor_ult, g.GUAR_AMT, g.GUAR_TYP, g.STATUS, g.EFF_DT, g.EXP_DT
FROM dbo.GUARANTEE g JOIN u ON u.ENTITY_ID=g.GUARANTOR_ENTITY_ID
WHERE u.ult IN (SELECT ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT) AND g.STATUS='ACTIVE' AND g.EFF_DT<='2026-09-30' AND g.EXP_DT>='2026-09-30'

SELECT c.CIF_NO, c.CLIENT_NM, COUNT(f.FACILITY_ID) n_fac, SUM(f.COMMIT_AMT) commit_amt FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.CIF_NO=c.CIF_NO AND f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE'
WHERE c.CIF_NO IN ('0000041005','0000041012','0000041090','0000041099','0000041123','0000041199','0000041277','0000041285','0000041527','0000041639','0000041379','0000041224','0000041214','0000041483','0000041569') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
